milestones.name: Defeat Elder Hu
milestones.note: Spirit fought at his memorial above the gates to the City of Tears; requires Dream Nail to trigger the fight

milestones.name: Acquire Dream Nail
milestones.note: Required prerequisite to fight Elder Hu's spirit

milestones.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
milestones.note: Earned upon defeating Elder Hu; collected via Dream Nail

milestones.name: Defeat Elder Baldur
milestones.note: Required to enter Greenpath; Elder Baldur blocks the entrance

milestones.name: Acquire Vengeful Spirit
milestones.note: Obtained from the Snail Shaman in the Ancestral Mound; required to defeat Elder Baldur and enter Greenpath

zones.name: Greenpath
zones.fingerprintHint: Lush green area; entrance blocked by Elder Baldur

zones.name: City of Tears
zones.fingerprintHint: Elder Hu's memorial is located above its gates

zones.name: Mantis Village
zones.fingerprintHint: Location where Elder Hu was killed by the Mantis Tribe; home of the Mantis Lords

zones.name: Ancestral Mound
zones.fingerprintHint: Home of the Snail Shaman; source of the Vengeful Spirit spell

zones.name: Queen's Gardens
zones.note: Location of the corpse holding the Love Key, as referenced in segment

abilities.name: Dream Nail
abilities.grants: Ability to fight spirits of the dead and collect Essence; also allows Dream Nailing corpses/objects for dialogue
abilities.note: Required to initiate the Elder Hu boss fight and collect 100 Essence upon his defeat

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirit
abilities.grants: Spell projectile; required to defeat Elder Baldur blocking Greenpath entrance

abilities.name: Shade Cloak
abilities.grants: Enhanced dash that passes through hazards; highly recommended for dodging Elder Hu's Ring Slam and Ring Curtain attacks
abilities.note: Not strictly required but strongly advised for the Elder Hu fight

abilities.name: Howling Wraiths
abilities.note: Spell usable in the Elder Hu fight, especially effective with a Spell build

abilities.name: Abyss Shriek
abilities.note: Upgraded form of Howling Wraiths; usable in the Elder Hu fight with a Spell build

abilities.name: Love Key
abilities.note: Held by the large dead Husk Dandy corpse; the corpse can be Dream Nailed for dialogue

bosses.name: Elder Hu
bosses.note: Ghost/spirit boss fought at his memorial above the City of Tears gates. Requires Dream Nail to initiate. Attacks: Ring Slam, Ring Curtain, Teleport. Drops 100 Essence on defeat.

bosses.name: Elder Baldur
bosses.note: Blocks the entrance to Greenpath; must be defeated using the Vengeful Spirit spell to gain access.

bosses.name: Mantis Lords
bosses.note: Mentioned in lore context; killed Elder Hu after he attacked them in his Infected delusion.

objectives.name: Enter Greenpath
objectives.hopDescription: Obtain Vengeful Spirit from the Snail Shaman in the Ancestral Mound, then use it to defeat the Elder Baldur blocking Greenpath's entrance.
objectives.note: Gate-keeping requirement to access Greenpath at all

objectives.name: Fight Elder Hu's Spirit
objectives.hopDescription: Acquire the Dream Nail, then travel to Elder Hu's memorial above the gates to the City of Tears and use Dream Nail to initiate the fight.
objectives.note: Prerequisite: Dream Nail must already be obtained

objectives.name: Collect 100 Essence from Elder Hu
objectives.hopDescription: After defeating Elder Hu, collect the 100 Essence he shatters into using the Dream Nail.

objectives.name: Obtain the Love Key
objectives.hopDescription: Locate the large dead Husk Dandy corpse in Queen's Gardens and collect the Love Key it is holding.
objectives.note: The corpse can optionally be Dream Nailed for lore dialogue
